title: Consolidate seldom-used variants and establish layer-order + auto-layout guidelines for components
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Reduce component surface area in the Figma library by consolidating rarely used variants into clear subsets, enforce a consistent layer order for accessibility and token mapping, and fix auto-layout anomalies so publishing is predictable. Scope: buttons, input fields, table rows, simple charts, icon-button combos, and associated tokens (spacing, radii, typography). Out of scope: new component patterns or full token renames.
updates: 2025-02-12: Audit complete — sampled 120 components across library. Identified ~220 low-usage variants (usage <0.5% telemetry) and 67 components with broken auto-layout constraints.
2025-02-18: Draft rules established for canonical layer order: background > border > container > icon > text > overlay. Shared with PM and accessibility for review.

2025-02-24: Implemented variant consolidation on a forked Figma file (Figma: Component Hygiene - draft). Merged size+state variants where possible and converted redundant boolean variants into token-driven flags.
2025-02-27: Eng feedback from Eve Martinez: requested clearer mapping between layer order and token names for runtime extraction. Added explicit token naming convention to doc.

2025-03-02: Created GitHub PR for publishing automation changes that validate component layer names before publishing (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/538). CI currently failing on 4 components — investigating.
2025-03-04: Codeowner review requested from design leads and runtime team. Preparing release notes for ui-kit-2025.03.
acceptance_criteria: All low-usage variants either consolidated or documented with rationale
Formalized layer-order documented and applied to at least 90% of core components (buttons, inputs, table rows, simple charts)
Auto-layout fixes applied and validated in Figma with token-driven spacing (using spacing tokens: spacing-xs, spacing-sm, spacing-md)
Publish checklist updated and CI validation added to ui-kit repo
Design lead and runtime engineer approval recorded in comments
design_decisions: Flatten variant axes: use size + intent as primary axes; move visual states (loading, disabled) to token flags when possible
Adopt canonical layer order so runtime mapping is deterministic
Prefer auto-layout with explicit token-based padding rather than manual frames to reduce drift
Keep legacy variants marked with suffix _legacy for two releases before deletion to allow rollout
next_steps: Finish CI failures on PR #538 and re-run component name validator
Schedule 1-hour handoff with runtime team (Eve Martinez) to confirm token mappings
Publish to production Figma library after design lead sign-off and update release notes
Create follow-up ticket to monitor telemetry for regressions post-publish (estimate 1)
